name: upper-arm blood-pressure monitor
definition: home device whose cuff wraps the upper arm and which reads blood pressure and pulse.
notes: Walgreens, Best Buy and Beurer list upper-arm cuff monitors under this name

name: wrist blood-pressure monitor
definition: home device worn on the wrist for a blood-pressure reading.
notes: Wrist monitors sold as their own type (Omron 7 Series wrist, Beurer Premium 800W)

name: wearable blood-pressure monitor
definition: watch-style or band-style device that measures blood pressure while worn.
notes: Omron HeartGuide sold as wearable BP monitor in smartwatch form

name: electronic stick thermometer
definition: electronic probe thermometer read orally, rectally or under the arm.
notes: Vicks Rapid Read digital thermometer for oral, rectal or underarm use

name: ear thermometer
definition: infrared thermometer that reads the eardrum.
notes: Braun ThermoScan ear thermometer; Beurer FT58 ear thermometer

name: forehead thermometer
definition: infrared thermometer that reads the temple or forehead.
notes: Walgreens category Forehead (Temporal) Thermometers with named products

name: blood glucose meter
definition: handheld meter that reads a drop of blood on a test strip (fingerstick).
notes: ADA consumer guide meter category; Walgreens meter list

name: continuous glucose monitor
definition: worn sensor that measures glucose under the skin and sends readings on its own at short intervals.
notes: ADA CGM category: Dexcom G6/G7/Stelo, Libre 2/3, Eversense

name: flash glucose monitor
definition: worn sensor whose readings are fetched by scanning it with a reader or phone.
notes: Libre 14-Day sensor must be scanned by phone or reader to read

name: pulse oximeter
definition: clip or band device that reads blood oxygen saturation and pulse.
notes: Walgreens finger pulse oximeters; Beurer PO30 fingertip oximeter

name: personal ECG monitor
definition: handheld or worn device that records an electrocardiogram.
notes: AliveCor KardiaMobile single-lead personal EKG; Beurer EKG monitor ME75

name: at-home infection test kit
definition: self-test kit for an infection (for example COVID-19 or flu; a combined test is this one kind).
notes: Walgreens at-home COVID tests and COVID+flu combination tests

name: pregnancy test
definition: one-use urine test that shows whether the user is pregnant.
notes: Walgreens pregnancy test category

name: ovulation test
definition: one-use urine test that finds the hormone surge before ovulation.
notes: Superdrug ovulation test category

name: fertility monitor
definition: reusable reader with test sticks or sensors that tracks the fertile window.
notes: Retail page titled Clearblue Fertility Monitor; page text thin

name: basal-body thermometer
definition: sensitive thermometer made to track resting body temperature for fertility.
notes: Beurer Bluetooth basal thermometer OT30 for ovulation/fertility tracking

name: medical app
definition: software that itself diagnoses, treats or is cleared as a medical device; an app that only records and shows readings from a separate device is not this kind.
notes: FDA De Novo record: Natural Cycles, stand-alone software application for contraception

name: nebuliser
definition: device that turns liquid medicine into a mist to be breathed in.
notes: Omron nebuliser range: compressor and mesh nebulisers

name: TENS unit
definition: pulse generator with skin pads, sold to relieve pain by nerve stimulation.
notes: Beurer TENS/EMS category with TENS units

name: EMS unit sold for pain
definition: muscle-stimulation unit with skin pads, sold to relieve pain.
notes: Compex Mini EMS stimulator with pain-management TENS program; Beurer EM49 EMS+TENS

name: weighted blanket
definition: blanket loaded with weight, made to treat a stated condition.
notes: Weighted blankets sold for autism, sensory processing disorder, anxiety

name: orthopaedic pillow
definition: shaped pillow made to treat a stated condition (a therapeutic weighted pillow is this kind with a `weight` value).
notes: Mediflow water pillow sold for neck pain; FDA-registered medical device claim

name: pelvic-floor trainer
definition: device that trains the pelvic-floor muscles, sold with a stated medical purpose.
notes: Elvie Trainer for pelvic floor dysfunction; Elitone FDA-cleared for continence recovery

name: vacuum erection device
definition: vacuum cylinder and pump used to obtain an erection, sold with a stated medical purpose.
notes: Timm Medical and Osbon vacuum therapy systems for erectile dysfunction

name: ED ring
definition: ring worn at the base of the penis to keep an erection, sold with a stated medical purpose.
notes: Timm Medical tension rings category; Osbon tension rings

name: vaginal dilator
definition: graduated dilator used to widen or restore vaginal capacity (provisional as a sold kind, H-14).
notes: Vitality Medical vaginal dilators category (vaginismus, dyspareunia use)

name: walking stick
definition: single hand-held stick or cane.
notes: Walking sticks and canes category; HurryCane walking stick

name: forearm crutch
definition: crutch with a forearm cuff and a handgrip.
notes: Forearm platform trough crutches, bariatric forearm crutches; Affinity forearm crutches

name: underarm crutch
definition: crutch that rests under the armpit.
notes: Aluminium underarm adult and youth crutches

name: walking frame
definition: frame without wheels, or with two front wheels, that the user lifts or pushes (`wheel_count` 0 or 2).
notes: Standard walkers and walking frames; hybrid walkers with front wheels

name: rollator
definition: walking support on three or four wheels with hand brakes; four-wheeled models usually have a seat and bag (`wheel_count` 3 or 4; Deltarad, delta walker, tri-walker and 3-wheel rollator are aliases of the three-wheel form).
notes: Rolling walkers (rollators) with seat and hand brakes; 3-wheel and tri walkers listed beside

name: knee walker
definition: wheeled frame with a knee rest, used in place of crutches for a lower-leg injury.
notes: Knee walkers (knee scooters) category

name: manual wheelchair
definition: wheelchair propelled by the user or a pusher.
notes: Manual wheelchairs: standard, lightweight, transport, heavy duty, beach

name: powered wheelchair
definition: wheelchair driven by an electric motor.
notes: Power wheelchairs category incl. Pride Jazzy Ultra Light folding powerchair

name: mobility scooter
definition: electric seated vehicle with tiller steering made for a person with limited mobility.
notes: Mobility scooters category: 3-wheel, 4-wheel, foldable

name: portable ramp
definition: ramp for a wheelchair or scooter over steps or kerbs.
notes: Portable wheelchair ramps category

name: patient lift
definition: hoist or lift that raises and moves a person.
notes: Invacare patient lifts: electric, hydraulic, sit-to-stand

name: stairlift
definition: chair or platform that carries a person up and down a staircase (installed or free-standing is an attribute).
notes: Stannah stairlifts: straight, curved, outdoor, standing models

name: shower chair
definition: chair, stool or bench for sitting while washing.
notes: Shower Chairs category (Binsons); Drive bath benches and stools

name: grab bar
definition: rail fixed or clamped to give a hand-hold, for example by a bath or toilet (UK grab rail).
notes: Drive Grab Bars category; Binsons grab bar products

name: commode chair
definition: chair with a seat opening and a removable pail, used as a toilet, also when it is made to be used in a shower.
notes: Drive commodes (standard, drop arm, bariatric); Binsons bedside commodes

name: raised toilet seat
definition: seat that raises the height of a toilet.
notes: Drive raised toilet seats category; Binsons raised toilet seats

name: incontinence product
definition: absorbent pad, brief or similar made for urinary or bowel leakage.
notes: TENA incontinence briefs and pads shop

name: stoma appliance
definition: bag, flange or similar supply for a stoma.
notes: Coloplast SenSura Mio ostomy pouching systems (bags and baseplates)

name: care bed
definition: adjustable bed for nursing care (a hospital bed is this kind).
notes: Invacare full-electric hospital-style homecare bed; Drive homecare beds

name: pressure-relief mattress
definition: mattress made to prevent or treat pressure sores.
notes: Invacare Solace Prevention hospital-bed mattress for pressure relief

name: pressure-relief cushion
definition: seat cushion made to prevent or treat pressure sores, including cushions used in wheelchairs.
notes: JAY Fusion wheelchair cushion engineered to protect against pressure injuries

name: examination table
definition: table for a clinical examination.
notes: Midmark 626 Barrier-Free Examination Chair; Clinton power exam table

name: treatment couch
definition: couch for therapy or treatment.
notes: CME Corp treatment tables: Clinton, Brewer, Oakworks, Armedica

name: dental chair
definition: chair for dental treatment.
notes: A-dec 500 dental chair; MTI oral/dental surgery chairs

name: medical ID bracelet
definition: wrist band carrying medical information.
notes: American Medical ID bracelet collection (91 results)

name: medical ID tag
definition: tag, card or keyring carrying medical information.
notes: Stainless Steel Dog Tag Red medical ID; QR Medical IDs category

name: fall detector
definition: worn device made mainly to sense a fall and call for help.
notes: Tunstall Lifeline Fall Detector and Vibby Oak S Fall Detector

name: care pendant
definition: worn call button that summons help after a fall or medical event; automatic fall sensing on it is an attribute.
notes: Tunstall Lifeline Pendant and MyAmie call-button pendants

name: wandering detector
definition: device that alerts carers when a person leaves a place.
notes: SMPL Wander Alert door/motion alarm kit alerting carers
